document.title: Document

organization.pageDescription: Company structure, levels, positions and reporting relationships.
organization.heroDescription: Business Unit, Level / Grade, Position and Reporting Lines become shared organization data for the rest of Q BMS.
organization.setupDescription: We will build the organization foundation in this sequence.
organization.businessUnitDescription: Maintain the business scopes used across Q BMS.
organization.levelGradeDescription: Define the company job level and job grade structure.
organization.positionDescription: Group roles into Job Families and map each Position to one or more allowed Grades.
organization.reportingLinesDescription: Build employee reporting relationships and organization chart.
organization.organizationChartDescription: Read-only company hierarchy generated automatically from Employee Assignments and Reporting Lines.

businessUnit.pageDescription: Organization master data for company business scopes.
businessUnit.heroDescription: Business Units define the business scope used across employee records, positions and future reporting.
businessUnit.masterDescription: Data is loaded from PostgreSQL through the Organization API.
businessUnit.errorHint: Make sure the backend is running at http://localhost:4000.

levelGrade.pageDescription: Company job level and job grade structure.
levelGrade.searchPlaceholder: Search level, grade or position group...
levelGrade.heroDescription: A shared hierarchy for job seniority, position mapping and employee organization data.
levelGrade.noticeTitle: Experience and education are reference criteria.
levelGrade.noticeBody: Q BMS stores them as HR guidance. They are not hard validation rules that block an appointment or employee setup.
levelGrade.errorHint: Confirm that the backend is running on port 4000.

position.pageDescription: Job Families, actual Positions and their allowed Grade ranges.
position.searchPlaceholder: Search job family, position, code, grade or level...
position.heroDescription: Organize related roles into Job Families, then define each Position with one or more allowed Job Grades. Job Level is always derived from Grade.
position.noticeTitle: One Position can cover multiple Grades and Levels.
position.noticeBody: Example: Sales Manager can allow Grade 7 and Grade 8. Q BMS derives the corresponding Job Levels automatically. Business Unit will be assigned with the employee, so the same Position does not need to be duplicated for every Business Unit.
position.jobFamilyDescription: Groups related career paths such as Sales, Finance, Product, HR or IT.
position.familyEmptyBody: The foundation is ready. Job Families will be created before loading the actual Position master.
position.masterDescription: Each Position belongs to a Job Family and may be valid for one or several Job Grades.
position.loadingBody: Reading Job Families, Positions and Grade mappings...
position.errorHint: Make sure the backend is running at http://localhost:4000.
position.emptyBody: The new multi-grade Position foundation is ready. We can now create Job Families and Positions without duplicating the same title for every Grade or Business Unit.
position.formDescription: Create the actual job title once, link it to a Job Family, then select every Job Grade that this Position can legitimately hold.
position.basicInformationHint: Position code, Job Family, status and display order.
position.codeHint: Unique Position code. Business Unit is intentionally not part of the code.
position.gradeSectionHint: Select one or more Grades. Job Level is calculated automatically from the selected Grades.
position.noLevelSelected: Select at least one Grade to calculate Level coverage.
position.languageSectionHint: English is the source language. Thai and Lao can fall back to English.

namePlaceholder.th: เช่น ผู้จัดการฝ่ายขาย
namePlaceholder.lo: ຕົວຢ່າງ: ຜູ້ຈັດການຝ່າຍຂາຍ

descriptionPlaceholder.th: คำอธิบายตำแหน่งงาน (ถ้ามี)

position.validationGrades: Please select at least one allowed Job Grade.
position.noFamilyFormTitle: A Job Family is required before creating a Position.
position.noFamilyFormBody: Create at least one active Job Family, then return here to define the Position.

jobFamily.pageDescription: Maintain the career and functional groups used to organize Positions.
jobFamily.searchPlaceholder: Search job family, code or description...
jobFamily.heroDescription: Create the master groups that organize related Positions, such as Sales, Finance, Product, HR or IT.
jobFamily.noticeTitle: Job Family groups related Positions; it is not a Grade or Level.
jobFamily.noticeBody: For example, Sales is a Job Family. Sales Executive, Sales Manager and Head of Sales are Positions inside that family. Grade and Level are handled separately.
jobFamily.masterDescription: Create each family once, then reuse it across all related Positions.
jobFamily.errorHint: Make sure the backend is running at http://localhost:4000.
jobFamily.emptyBody: Create the first Job Family before defining actual Positions.
jobFamily.formDescription: Define the family once. Positions such as Sales Executive or Sales Manager will be linked to it later.
jobFamily.codeHint: Unique master code. Spaces are converted to hyphens.
jobFamily.languageSectionHint: English is the source language. Thai and Lao can fall back to English.
jobFamily.name: Job Family Name

namePlaceholder.th: เช่น ฝ่ายขาย
namePlaceholder.lo: ຕົວຢ່າງ: ຝ່າຍຂາຍ

descriptionPlaceholder.en: Optional description of this career / function group
descriptionPlaceholder.th: คำอธิบายกลุ่มสายงาน (ถ้ามี)
descriptionPlaceholder.lo: ຄຳອະທິບາຍກຸ່ມສາຍວຽກ (ຖ້າມີ)

jobFamily.validationEnglishName: English Job Family Name is required.
jobFamily.formLoadError: Unable to load Job Family details.

employee.pageDescription: Employee master records and New Employee onboarding status.
employee.searchPlaceholder: Search employee, code, Company Email, Business Unit, Position, Grade or onboarding status...
employee.heroDescription: Create New Employees before their company account exists. Q BMS creates the Pre-Onboarding record and IT account setup request automatically.
employee.noticeTitle: New Employee is now the standard HR entry flow.
employee.noticeBody: HR creates the employee first. Company Email is not required yet. Q BMS sets Pre-Onboarding + New Hire automatically and creates an IT account setup request. Existing Employee import remains a separate initial migration utility.
employee.masterDescription: Employee identity, organization assignment and onboarding progress.
employee.loadingBody: Reading employee records and organization assignments...
employee.errorHint: Make sure the backend is running at http://localhost:4000.
employee.emptyBody: Create the first New Employee. Company Email will be added later by IT after Google Workspace account setup.
employee.formDescription: HR creates the employee before IT creates the company account. Workflow-owned fields are set automatically.
employee.personalSectionHint: Basic employee identity required before IT account setup.
employee.assignmentSectionHint: Current primary assignment. Job Level is derived from Grade.
employee.levelAuto: Job Level will appear after selecting a Grade.
employee.departmentHoldNote: Department is intentionally not required while the Department structure remains on HOLD.
employee.employmentSectionHint: Employment details entered by HR. Workflow status is managed automatically.
employee.waitingItHint: Open Google Workspace account setup requests
employee.editDescription: Edit HR-owned employee and assignment data. Company Email and onboarding statuses are controlled by the onboarding workflow.
employee.workflowManagedBody: Company Email, Employee Status, Record Type, IT setup, invitation and Q BMS access are not edited directly from Employee Master.
employee.newEmployeeWorkflowTitle: Q BMS will start Pre-Onboarding automatically
employee.newEmployeeWorkflowBody: After this record is created, Q BMS creates a pending IT account setup request. IT will create the Google Workspace account and confirm the Company Email in the next step.
employee.activeAssignmentLocked: Active Employee organization fields are history-protected. Use Organization Assignment Management for transfer, promotion or other organization changes.

accountSetup.pageDescription: Create and confirm Google Workspace accounts for New Employees.
accountSetup.searchPlaceholder: Search employee, code, Business Unit, Position, Company Email or status...
accountSetup.heroDescription: Every New Employee created by HR automatically creates an IT account setup request. IT works from this queue and confirms the Company Email when the Google Workspace account is ready.
accountSetup.triggerBody: Creating a New Employee now creates both the IT work item and a Notification event automatically. In-app routing is ready. Role-targeted Email delivery is kept in the notification outbox until Google Workspace mail delivery is connected.
accountSetup.queueDescription: Pending and in-progress Google Workspace account requests for New Employees.
accountSetup.errorTitle: Unable to load IT Account Setup Queue
accountSetup.errorHint: Make sure migration 008 is applied and the backend is running at http://localhost:4000.
accountSetup.emptyBody: When HR creates a New Employee, the account setup request will appear here automatically.
accountSetup.modalDescription: After IT creates the Google Workspace account, confirm the Company Email here.
accountSetup.emailHint: Must use the company Workspace domain: @iquritech.com.
accountSetup.itNotePlaceholder: Optional setup note, account naming note, or handoff detail...
accountSetup.afterConfirmBody: Q BMS saves the Company Email, marks IT Account Setup as Completed, prepares the employee Invitation Draft and creates a notification event for HR.

itAdmin.pageDescription: IT administration workspace for employee accounts, access, requests and assigned devices.
itAdmin.heroDescription: A dedicated workspace for IT operational work. Account Setup is active now; access management, IT requests and device assignment are reserved as the next capabilities.
itAdmin.principleTitle: IT Admin is a capability-based Tool
itAdmin.principleBody: Access to this Tool should come from permissions such as IT Account Admin—not from an employee being in a specific Department. Department remains separate from system capability.
itAdmin.workspaceDescription: Operational areas owned by IT Admin while master data continues to live in shared Q BMS Modules.

accountSetup.title: Account Setup
accountSetup.description: Process New Employee Google Workspace account requests and confirm the Company Email.

accessManagement.title: Access Management
accessManagement.description: Manage system access, account suspension and future application access controls.

itRequests.title: IT Requests
itRequests.description: Receive and track employee IT support, access and account requests.

deviceAssignment.title: Device Assignment
deviceAssignment.description: Assign and return employee devices using shared Asset master data.

itAdmin.flowDescription: The Employee Module creates the request; IT Admin owns the operational account-setup work and sends the result back to HR through the workflow.
itAdmin.loadError: Unable to load IT Admin workload.

hrm.pageDescription: Human Resources Management workspace for employee onboarding and workforce operations.
hrm.heroDescription: A dedicated workspace for HR workflows. Employee Invitation is available now; onboarding, attendance and performance capabilities remain reserved for the next phases.
hrm.workspaceDescription: Operational HR workflows built on shared Employee and Organization master data.

invitation.title: Employee Invitations
invitation.description: Invite employees after IT confirms their Company Email.

onboarding.title: Employee Onboarding
onboarding.description: Review profile completion, onboarding status and activation workflow.

attendance.title: Attendance & Leave
attendance.description: Manage attendance, leave and employee time-related workflows.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Manage KPI, performance reviews and employee development workflows.

hrm.flowDescription: HR creates the employee, IT prepares the Company Email, HR sends the invitation, then the employee signs in with Google and completes the profile.

hrInvitation.pageDescription: Manage onboarding invitations for employees whose Company Email is ready.
hrInvitation.heroDescription: IT-completed employees appear here automatically. HR can queue the Q BMS invitation when the Company Email is ready.
hrInvitation.searchPlaceholder: Search employee, email, business unit or position...
hrInvitation.deliveryTitle: Invitation workflow is ready for end-to-end testing
hrInvitation.deliveryBody: Queue Invitation creates the invitation and Notification Outbox email target. For local testing, use Copy activation link to continue Google Login / Identity Linking. Production Google Workspace mail delivery remains a separate transport integration and Q BMS will not falsely mark queued mail as sent.
hrInvitation.queueDescription: Employees appear here after IT Admin completes Company Email setup.
hrInvitation.emptyBody: Complete a New Employee account setup in IT Admin first. The employee will appear here automatically after Company Email is confirmed.
hrInvitation.copySuccess: Activation link copied. Open it in a signed-out/private browser to test the employee flow.

authLogin.brandDescription: Access people, operations, sales, finance and system tools from one secure Q BMS workspace.
authLogin.subtitle: Sign in once with your company Google Workspace account. Q BMS will load your employee profile, system roles and permissions automatically.
authLogin.signInDescription: Employees, managers and system administrators use the same secure sign-in. Access is determined by your Q BMS account after authentication.
authLogin.workspaceHint: Use your company Google Workspace account
authLogin.foundationNotice: Google Workspace SSO is the next authentication step. The routing and secure session foundation is now connected; Google identity is not enabled yet.
authLogin.accessNote: There is no separate Super Admin login. Special system access is granted through Q BMS roles and permissions after sign-in.
authLogin.developmentPreviewHint: Creates a temporary local workspace session only. It does not sign in as an employee or grant any system role.
authLogin.previewError: Unable to open the development workspace.
authLogin.googleNotConfigured: Google Workspace SSO code is ready, but this environment still needs the Google OAuth Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI and Workspace Domain in the backend environment settings.
authLogin.googleConfigured: Google Workspace SSO is configured and ready for company sign-in.

authActivation.title: Activate your Q BMS account
authActivation.subtitle: Verify the invitation and continue with the company Google Workspace account assigned to you by IT.
authActivation.missingInvitation: The invitation link is incomplete. Please open the activation link from the email sent by Q BMS.
authActivation.instruction: Google must return the same company email as this invitation. A different Google account will not be linked to this employee.
authActivation.googleNotConfigured: Google Workspace SSO is not configured in this environment yet. The invitation is valid, but authentication cannot start until OAuth settings are added.
authActivation.contactHelp: Contact HR or IT Admin if you need help

authFirstLogin.description: Your Google Workspace identity is now linked to your Q BMS employee account. Employment information and system access remain separate by design.
authFirstLogin.noSpecialRoles: No special system role assigned yet
authFirstLogin.roleSeparation: System roles such as Super Admin are independent from Position, Job Grade and Job Level.
authFirstLogin.completeProfileHint: Your identity is active for onboarding. Personal profile fields will be completed in the Employee Profile workflow before full workspace access is granted.
authFirstLogin.pendingHrReview: Profile submitted — waiting for HR review
authFirstLogin.pendingHrReviewHint: Your Q BMS account will receive normal workspace access after the onboarding review is completed.
authFirstLogin.foundationNote: Authentication and first-sign-in routing are active. Personal data collection remains part of the Employee Profile / HRM workflow and is intentionally not invented inside the authentication module.
